title: Flying Cats
question: How do cats try to protect themselves when falling from great heights?

meanings.usage: 主语可以是人或事物，常用搭配：sth fascinates sb 某物吸引某人；be fascinated by/with 被……吸引
常用于描述人或动物的态度，常用搭配：be affectionate towards sb 对某人亲切友爱
可修饰人、事物或现象，用来描述不为人知的特性
常用来描述人或动物愿意服从他人指令的状态，搭配：be submissive to sb 对某人顺从
多用于正式语境修饰和猫相关的特性，也可作名词表示“猫科动物”
不可数名词，常见搭配：gain independence 获得独立；respect one's independence 尊重某人的独立性
常用搭配：be suspicious of sb/sth 对某人/某物心存怀疑
多用于句首或句中，说明根据现有情况得出的明显结论
可作及物动词直接接宾语（survive sth 从某事故中幸存），也可作不及物动词
常用搭配：be ideal for sth/sb 对某事/某人来说是理想的
可数/不可数名词，搭配：shortage of sth 某物短缺；no shortage of 不缺少……
可数名词，指受过跳伞训练的军人
不可数名词，常用搭配：air resistance 空气阻力；resistance to sth 对……的抵抗力
表示“冲击力”时为不可数，表“影响”时可数/不可数，搭配：impact of sth 某物的影响；shock of impact 撞击冲击

phrases.usage: 双重否定结构，加强肯定语气，意为“一定会；从未不”，语气比直接用肯定形式更强烈

examples.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
examples.zh: 猫总能引起人类的极大兴趣。

examples.en: She never fails to call her parents every weekend.
examples.zh: 她每个周末一定会给父母打电话。

phrases.usage: 表示“以……为基础；基于……”，主语通常为理论、故事、结论等抽象事物

examples.en: A cat's ability to survive falls is based on fact.
examples.zh: 猫在坠落中存活的能力是有事实依据的。

examples.en: The movie is based on a real historical event.
examples.zh: 这部电影是基于真实历史事件改编的。

phrases.usage: 表示“有共同之处”，可接介词with表示“和某人/某物有共同点”

examples.en: All these cats had one experience in common: they had fallen off high buildings.
examples.zh: 所有这些猫都有一个共同的经历：它们都曾从高楼上掉下来过。

examples.en: The two sisters have nothing in common in terms of hobbies.
examples.zh: 这两姐妹在爱好方面没有任何共同点。

phrases.usage: 表示“死于（外部原因，如事故、伤害等）”，区别于die of（多用于死于内部疾病、情感等）

examples.en: Only eight of them died from shock or injuries.
examples.zh: 它们中只有8只死于休克或受伤。

examples.en: Many people in the accident died from serious burns.
examples.zh: 事故中的很多人死于严重烧伤。

phrases.usage: 表示“不缺少；充足的”，后接可数名词复数或不可数名词

examples.en: There is no shortage of tall buildings in New York.
examples.zh: 纽约不缺高楼大厦。

examples.en: There is no shortage of talented young people in this industry.
examples.zh: 这个行业里不缺有天赋的年轻人。

phrases.usage: 表示“遭受；患有（疾病、伤痛等）”，后接具体的病痛、困难等名词

examples.en: Sabrina fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth.
examples.zh: 萨布丽娜从32层楼掉下来，却只断了一颗牙。

examples.en: Many office workers suffer from back pain these days.
examples.zh: 现在很多上班族都有背痛的问题。

phrases.usage: 表示“伸展；伸开（肢体）”，可接宾语也可单独使用

examples.en: They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels.
examples.zh: 它们把腿伸展开，就像飞鼠一样。

examples.en: He stretched out on the sofa and fell asleep soon.
examples.zh: 他在沙发上舒展身体，很快就睡着了。

sentences.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
sentences.zh: 猫总是能吸引人类。

sentences.en: They can be friendly and affectionate towards humans, but they lead mysterious lives of their own as well.
sentences.zh: 它们可以对人类友好和亲热，但它们也有自己的神秘生活。

sentences.en: They never become submissive like dogs and horses.
sentences.zh: 它们从不像狗和马那样变得顺从。

sentences.en: As a result, humans have learned to respect feline independence.
sentences.zh: 结果，人类学会了尊重猫的独立性。

sentences.en: Most cats remain suspicious of humans all their lives.
sentences.zh: 大多数猫一生都对人类保持警惕。

sentences.en: One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief that they have nine lives.
sentences.zh: 关于猫最吸引我们的一点是，人们普遍认为它们有九条命。

sentences.en: Apparently, there is a good deal of truth in this idea.
sentences.zh: 显然，这种说法有相当多的真实性。

sentences.en: A cat's ability to survive falls is based on fact.
sentences.zh: 猫从高处跌落后幸存的能力是有事实依据的。

sentences.en: Recently the New York Animal Medical Centre made a study of 132 cats over a period of five months.
sentences.zh: 最近，纽约动物医疗中心对132只猫进行了为期五个月的研究。

sentences.en: All these cats had one experience in common: they had fallen off high buildings,
sentences.zh: 所有这些猫都有一个共同的经历：它们都从高楼上跌落过，

sentences.en: yet only eight of them died from shock or injuries.
sentences.zh: 然而只有八只死于休克或受伤。

sentences.en: Of course, New York is the ideal place for such an interesting study, because there is no shortage of tall buildings.
sentences.zh: 当然，纽约是进行这项有趣研究的理想地点，因为那里不缺少高楼大厦。

sentences.en: There are plenty of high-rise windowsills to fall from!
sentences.zh: 有很多高层窗台可供跌落！

sentences.en: One cat, Sabrina, fell 32 storeys, yet only suffered from a broken tooth.
sentences.zh: 一只名叫萨布丽娜的猫从32层楼高的地方摔下，却只受了牙齿折断的伤。

sentences.en: 'Cats behave like well-trained paratroopers,' a doctor said.
sentences.zh: “猫的行为就像训练有素的伞兵，”一位医生说。

sentences.en: It seems that the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves.
sentences.zh: 猫似乎跌落得越远，受伤的可能性就越小。

sentences.en: In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more.
sentences.zh: 在长距离跌落中，它们的速度可达每小时60英里甚至更高。

sentences.en: At high speeds, falling cats have time to relax.
sentences.zh: 在高速跌落时，猫有时间放松。

sentences.en: They stretch out their legs like flying squirrels.
sentences.zh: 它们像飞鼠一样伸展四肢。

sentences.en: This increases their air-resistance and reduces the shock of impact when they hit the ground.
sentences.zh: 这增加了它们的空气阻力，并减少了它们撞击地面时的冲击。

exercises.prompt: “幸存；活下来” 对应的单词是？
exercises.explain: survive · /səˈvaɪv/ · verb · 幸存；活下来。可作及物动词直接接宾语（survive sth 从某事故中幸存），也可作不及物动词

exercises.prompt: 根据释义和音标拼写单词：冲击力；影响
exercises.explain: impact · /ˈɪmpækt/ · noun · 冲击力；影响。表示“冲击力”时为不可数，表“影响”时可数/不可数，搭配：impact of sth 某物的影响；shock of impact 撞击冲击

exercises.prompt: 补全短语：Cats _____ fascinate human beings.
exercises.hint: 猫总能引起人类的极大兴趣。
exercises.explain: never fail to：双重否定结构，加强肯定语气，意为“一定会；从未不”，语气比直接用肯定形式更强烈（猫总能引起人类的极大兴趣。）

exercises.prompt: 补全句子：In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and _____
exercises.hint: 在长距离跌落中，它们的速度可达每小时60英里甚至更高。
exercises.explain: In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more. — 在长距离跌落中，它们的速度可达每小时60英里甚至更高。

source.en: In a long drop, they reach speeds of 60 miles an hour and more.

exercises.prompt: “表示“越……，就越……”，用于描述两个变化过程的相关性” 描述的是哪个语法点？
exercises.hint: The + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子，the + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子
options: While 引导的让步状语从句
the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构
exercises.explain: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构：The + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子，the + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子：第一个句子相当于条件状语，第二个句子是结果，语序通常为陈述语序，口语中可省略和主句相同的成分

source.title: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构

exercises.prompt:
选出下面句子的正确中文意思：
Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
options: 他们检查了各个房间，小心翼翼地不碰任何东西，
他原以为店员会目瞪口呆地看着他。
尽管她年代久远，但确实非常优雅，不过到目前为止，考古学家们还未能发现她的身份。
exercises.explain: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings. — 猫总是能吸引人类。

source.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.

grammar.title: the + 比较级, the + 比较级 结构
grammar.definition: 表示“越……，就越……”，用于描述两个变化过程的相关性
grammar.structure: The + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子，the + 形容词/副词比较级 + 句子
grammar.usage: 第一个句子相当于条件状语，第二个句子是结果，语序通常为陈述语序，口语中可省略和主句相同的成分

examples.en: It seems that the further cats fall, the less they are likely to injure themselves.
examples.zh: 看起来猫坠落的距离越远，它们受伤的可能性就越小。

examples.en: The harder you work, the more progress you will make.
examples.zh: 你越努力，取得的进步就越大。

grammar.title: It seems that 主语从句结构
grammar.definition: 用于表达不确定的判断或看起来的情况，意为“似乎；看起来好像”
grammar.structure: It seems that + 完整的陈述句
grammar.usage: it为形式主语，真正的主语是that引导的从句，可与sb/sth seems to do 结构互相转换

examples.en: It seems that there is a good deal of truth in this idea.
examples.zh: 这种说法似乎有不少道理。

examples.en: It seems that he has already known the news.
examples.zh: 他好像已经知道这个消息了。

original.en: Cats never fail to fascinate human beings.
original.zh: 猫总能引起人类的极大兴趣。

examples.en: Traditional Chinese festivals never fail to remind people of their family.
examples.zh: 中国传统节日总能让人们想起自己的家人。

examples.en: This movie never fails to make me cry every time I watch it.
examples.zh: 我每次看这部电影都会被弄哭。

patterns.pattern: One of the things that fascinates us most about ... is the popular belief that ...

original.en: One of the things that fascinates us most about cats is the popular belief that they have nine lives.
original.zh: 关于猫，最让我们着迷的一点是人们普遍认为它们有九条命。

examples.en: One of the things that fascinates us most about pandas is the popular belief that they are always gentle and cute.
examples.zh: 关于熊猫，最让我们着迷的一点是人们普遍认为它们总是温顺可爱的。

examples.en: One of the things that attracts visitors most about this city is the popular belief that it is a paradise for food lovers.
examples.zh: 关于这座城市，最吸引游客的一点是大家普遍认为它是美食爱好者的天堂。

patterns.pattern: ... make a study of ... over a period of ...

original.en: Recently the New York Animal Medical Centre made a study of 132 cats over a period of five months.
original.zh: 最近纽约动物医疗中心对132只猫进行了为期五个月的研究。

examples.en: The research team made a study of 500 primary school students over a period of two years.
examples.zh: 该研究团队对500名小学生进行了为期两年的研究。

examples.en: The company made a study of consumers' habits over a period of six months.
examples.zh: 该公司对消费者的习惯进行了为期六个月的研究。
